manifest_row.title: An Uncertain Future for Horticulture in Kashmir

screening.main_topic: The economic and agricultural crisis facing Kashmir’s apple growers after snowfall and other disruptions damaged crops and affected markets.
screening.climate_relevance: The article identifies climate change, in the form of early snowfall, as one contributor to the horticulture sector’s crisis and describes weather-related crop damage.
screening.reason: The main focus is on farmers’ losses, labor shortages, transport problems, and market prices rather than climate change. However, climate change is meaningfully linked to early snowfall and its effects on apple production, making the text relevant as peripheral climate discourse.
